```{r setup, echo = F, message = F}
library(tidyverse)
```

## Problem 1
Load the dataset:
```{r load}
data("penguins", package = "palmerpenguins")
```

The `penguins` dataset has information on the penguins' species, island, bill length (mm), bill depth (mm), flipper length(mm), body mass (g), sex, and year. 
The dataset has `r nrow(penguins)` observations and `r ncol(penguins)` variables. 
The mean flipper length is `r round(mean(pull(penguins, flipper_length_mm), na.rm = TRUE), 2)` mm.
